items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a family called Esterházy in Austria and they were like the patrons of Josef Haydn, the composer. Haydn wrote the first trumpet concerto that was written, and they hired me to play this.

ctx.x: Formal versus the informal address, sure. Do you have any honorary doctorates? So, you can put “Herr Doctor Arthur.”

No, I don’t have none of them yet. Last year, I played a concert in, I can’t remember the name, a little town… There was a family called Esterházy in Austria and they were like the patrons of Josef Haydn, the composer. Haydn wrote the first trumpet concerto that was written, and they hired me to play this. I never had played nothing like that over there. That was a real feather in the cap also. I would never get a chance to do that over here, unless I’d had a background in it. Things can happen. I never had run…
